provenance.funds.sustainable-enhanced-bonds.perform: SYNTHETIC e2e fixture: monthly net returns 2019-02 to 2026-08: analytics fund_returns.json "Nymbus Sustainable Enhanced Bonds" (54 month(s): 2019-02 to 2023-07; local file); dataplatform /api/performance/nav-timeseries LDM202 (cibc 2023-08 to 2026-06, bridge 2026-07) daily NAV chain compounded by the website (36 month(s): 2023-08 to 2026-07); dataplatform /api/performance/monthly-net-returns SEB class_code STRATEGY_H ready months (1: 2026-08); every month class_code STRATEGY_H, shown as class H; trailing/calendar/growth computed (compounded, annualized beyond 1 year), cross-checked with factsheet bonds_data_2026-08.json; index "FTSE Canada Universe Bond Index": computed from FTSE univ via dataplatform /api/ftse/index-summary, aggregate total-return level, month-end to month-end (history joined over univ_overall); value added = fund − FTSE index; factsheet bonds_data_2026-08.json index figures used as a cross-check only (its index was the XSB/XBB ETF before 2026-05)
provenance.funds.sustainable-enhanced-bonds.risk: SYNTHETIC e2e fixture: computed from the monthly net returns (SI and 3Y windows; population st.dev. ×√12; downside dev. = st.dev. of negative months ×√12; Sharpe and Sortino without risk-free rate, as in the factsheets; max drawdown from the running peak including the initial investment, whereas the factsheet uses month-end peaks only)

provenance.funds.sustainable-enhanced-bonds.portfol: SYNTHETIC e2e fixture: computed by the website from dataplatform /api/apex/holdings, /api/instruments/batch, /api/instruments (bond universe) and /api/performance/nav-timeseries (port of dataplatform PR #621 fund_portfolio.py): SEB FINAL_NAV book 2026-09-28; priced 100.0%, resolved 100.0% of the bond weight; weights: market_value_cad / net assets (sum of the classes' Apex closing capital), signed; duration: modified duration (instrument latest price), weighted by signed market value over bond positions, renormalised over covered weight; withheld when short bond positions exceed 0.5 % of net assets; labelled bond holdings only when futures are open (their exposure is not included)
